log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: All quick kills in MORNING (keeps pool at night+home = 35%). The pool only shrinks per distinct place kind that gets traced, so kill only from a few kinds. Day1 test: national + forum x2 + foreign x2. Read the press conference after day 3 (traces are in by then): ~2000 means forum and foreign are both accessible (stay on those 2 kinds, 5 kills/day); ~9000 means one of them is blocked; ~35000 means both are blocked (safe to add other kinds, e.g. regional or clips or blotter). Pool must stay above 1000. Need 30 deaths in 5 days for x2, 40 for x4. Timed entries could go in the evening (2 max) but they add no safety.

STRATEGY: All quick kills in MORNING, which keeps the pool at night workers plus at-home people, about 35%. The pool only shrinks for each distinct kind of place that gets traced, so kill only from a few kinds. Day 1 and day 2: each day national + forum x2 + foreign x2, all quick in the morning, 5 per day. Day 3: do the same again. Read the press conference after day 3 (traces are in by then). About 2000 means forum and foreign are both reachable by L: stay on those 2 kinds, 5 kills a day; 2000 x 0.25 would drop below 1000, so never add a third reachable kind. About 9000 means one of them is blocked: one more kind may be safe, but untested kinds are risky. About 35000 means both are blocked: safe to add one other kind (regional, clips or blotter), then watch the next press conference. Pool must stay above 1000. Need 30 deaths in 5 days for x2, 40 for x4. Timed entries could go in the evening (2 max) but add no safety.

DEDUCTION: After day 3 the pool was 9000. Morning-only kills leave night workers plus at-home people, 35000. 35000 x 0.25 = 8750, so exactly ONE of forum/foreign is reachable by L. Since L is blocked on 2 kinds in total, exactly one of regional, age(clips) and sector(blotter) is blocked and the other two are reachable. Day 4: added clips as the third kind (national + forum x2 + foreign x2 + clips x2, all quick in the morning, 7 kills). Worst case, clips is reachable and the pool becomes about 2200, still safe. NEVER add a 4th kind if clips turns out reachable, since that would give about 550 and I would be caught. READ the press conference after day 6. Still about 9000 means clips is blocked: then I may add regional OR blotter (one of them, not both); that kind is surely reachable and gives about 2200. About 2000 means clips is reachable: stay on national, forum, foreign and clips forever. Days 4 to 6: use national, forum, foreign and clips, 7 kills a day if available. Multiplier: the 5-day window from day 6 (days 2 to 6) is 5+5+7+7+7 = 31, so x2 from day 6 if 7 a day is kept. Kill every available criminal from the allowed kinds, all quick in the morning.
